typeInfo.description: High accuracy shooting from long range makes it perfect for targeting specific enemy parts.

description:
Snow White is now armed with new equipment powered by Eden's technology. Her previous armaments, Seven Dwarves, have been consolidated into a single system.
Having recovered all her memories, she is preparing to kill the Queen who desecrated Liliweiss.

levels.name: Seven Dwarves V+VI
levels.description:
■ Activates every 0.2 sec while charging. Affects the enemy unit nearest to the crosshair that is not the in Lock-On state.
<color=#00AEFF>Lock-On
Function: Designates the enemy as a target of Seven Dwarves.
Max Lock-On Targets: 5
<word_group=10097>Deactivation condition</word_group>: Performing a normal attack or <word_group=10095>taking cover</word_group>.</color>
■ Activates every 0.2 sec while charging. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Auto Fire Ready
Function: Loads Seven Dwarves with ammo.
Effect: DEF ▲ 24.96% continuously.
Max ammo loaded by Auto Fire Ready: 5
<word_group=10097>Deactivation condition</word_group>: Performing a normal attack.</color>
■ Activates every 0.2 sec while charging. Affects all enemies in the Lock-On state.
<color=#00AEFF>Damage Taken ▲ 2.48% for 4 sec.</color>
■ Activates when performing a Full Charge attack.
<color=#00AEFF>Auto Fire
Function: Attacks Lock-On targets with Seven Dwarves.
Effect 1: Deals 24.76% of <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK as damage. Affects all enemies.
Effect 2: Deals 62.39% of <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK as damage. Affects Lock-On targets. <word_group=10050>Attacks sequentially</word_group> based on the amount of ammo loaded by Auto Fire Ready.</color>
■ Activates when performing a Full Charge attack while in the Seven Dwarves Fully Active state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Number of uses of Seven Dwarves Fully Active ▼ 1.</color>
■ Activates when performing a normal attack while not in Full Burst. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Removes Seven Dwarves Fully Active.</color>

lines.text: I will kill the Queen. No matter the cost.
These weapons feel so light they seem weak.
You want me to install a storage case for rations? Carrying extra rounds or missiles would be far more useful.
All of my memories have returned. But... there is no going back.
This time... I will finally grant Lilith the true rest she deserves.
This may sound reckless, but as long as you're here, {AccountData.NickName}, I feel like everything will work out somehow.
I'll do some maintenance in the mean time, but don't make me wait too long.
Next time you disappear on me, at least leave some jerky behind. If that's too much to ask, a potato will do.
Someday, I'll make my way down to the Ark.
This is a nice place. Plenty to eat, and the ground is actually covered in grass.
Where's the food storage area? Just making sure I know where it is in case of an emergency.
The Queen defiled Lilith, and for that, she must die.
Feels like the weapons got heavier... Or maybe I'm imagining things.
I'm one step closer to killing the Queen.
I've grown stronger. You should aim to do the same.
Thanks for the food. This isn't edible, you say? Don't be so sure.
All right, I'll repay you with the rice ball I've been saving.
A gift, huh... Come to think of it, I've never given you a proper gift myself.
I wonder if we can ever go back to the past...
I trust you. So trust in me too.
I'm glad you haven't changed.
Come. Together, we'll kill the Queen.
My name's Snow White.
Very well. Let's go.
Encounter.
Don't bother praying. I'll be the one to kill your god.
For Lilith... may she rest in peace.
The Queen...!
Conducting maintenance.
We're not done. Keep going.
Ammo check. All good.
Seven Dwarves, ready.
Fully active! Pierce through...!
I'll kill them all, leaving nothing behind!
Got one. Next.
Hmm. These weapons are great.
I'm feeling peckish.
Hmm.
Is that it?
I'm hit.
There's still... work to be done!
Clear. But we've still got a long way to go.
... May Lilith find true peace.
I'm not quite used to this outfit. What do you think of it?
I may be dressed differently, but my duty hasn't changed.
Lilith was strong. I could never hope to compare to her... She was strong and beautiful.
Here. These flowers were meant for Lilith, but I suppose it wouldn't hurt to give you one.
Liliweiss. A beautiful flower that symbolizes pure love and sacrifice. It couldn't be more fitting...
I'll just be here straightening my outfit. I do hope you return soon.
... Were you waiting for me? Thank you. Your very presence is comforting.
Take pride in this place that you, Lilith, and everyone else fought to protect.
A field of flowers...? You should take in their beauty before they wither.
I was just at the Goddess of Victory statue, laying flowers. May she rest in peace.
It's me, Snow White. Would you care to spend the day with me?
Becoming stronger means refusing to lose anything else.
I still have a long way to go. I must become stronger for that day.
I'm a Goddess. I must see this through, even if I have to do it alone.
Is this a gift...? Thank you, but you don't have to pity me. That's not how we do things.
... This gift isn't half bad. Lilith would've liked it, too.
It feels like I'm always in your debt. I always have rice cakes ready to share, so just let me know if you'd like one.
We've known each other for quite a long time now. With you by my side, I know we'll make it to the end.
I'll protect you, just as Lilith protected me. So don't die.
Thank you for doing your best to ensure the light of the Goddess of Victory never fades.
I'm ready.
It's me, Snow White.
Let's move.
Encounter.
We'll show them that the Goddesses are here.
May Lilith's sacrifice not be in vain.
... Despicable bastards.
There's plenty of ammo.
This outfit is getting in the way.
Reloading.
Seven Dwarves, ready.
May Lilith find eternal peace.
I'll finish every last one of them. For Lilith.
How unruly.
Enemy silenced.
All clear.
It's just a scratch.
Minimal damage sustained.
Don't worry about it.
Not yet... I can still fight...!
Defeat isn't an option. That's how I fight.
